- The phone number associated with your account
- Your customer ID
- Your full name and date of birth

Once I have this information, I can check your line status and assist you further.
My name is Sofia Martinez and my phone number is +1-617-555-0148.

Please reboot your phone to regain network connectivity. After restarting, you should be able to make calls, use the internet, and send picture messages again.

Let me know if you still experience any issues after rebooting your device.

history.content: I’ve restarted my phone, but I’m still not getting any signal. There’s still no internet or service, and I can’t send picture messages.

Thank you for letting me know. Since your line is now active but you still have no signal, let's perform some troubleshooting steps to identify the cause.

Could you please check your phone’s status bar and let me know:
- Do you see an airplane icon (✈️)?
- Is there any signal strength indicator (bars)?
- Do you see any messages like “No Service” or “Emergency Calls Only”?

This information will help me guide you through the next steps.
I checked my phone, and now the status bar shows excellent signal, 5G, data enabled, and it says I'm connected to Chestnut-5G. What should I try next?

Thank you for the update. Since your phone now shows excellent signal, 5G, and data enabled, your cellular service appears to be restored. However, you mentioned you are connected to "Chestnut-5G," which is likely your Wi-Fi network.

To confirm everything is working:
1. Try turning off Wi-Fi on your phone and see if you can access the internet using only mobile data.
2. Try making a call or sending a picture message (MMS) with Wi-Fi turned off.

Please let me know if you can use the internet and send/receive calls and picture messages with Wi-Fi disabled. If you encounter any issues, let me know what happens, and I’ll assist you further.

I turned off Wi-Fi and tried to use the internet and send a picture message. The internet works fine on mobile data, and I was able to send a picture message without any issues. Everything seems to be working now.

That’s great to hear! Your service, mobile data, and picture messaging are all working as expected now.

If you experience any further issues or have any other questions, feel free to reach out. Have a wonderful day!
